purpose.summary: ORCR0840 is a batch COBOL program that is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software. It computes and aggregates diagnosis-category point totals for hospitalization receipts (specifically for long-term care / self-pay categories). It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM receipt files (RECE82, RECE84, RECE85, RECE8A, RECE8B) and produces an error file.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

notable_features: COPY ... REPLACING with pseudo-text delimiters (//token//) to reuse copybooks for multiple file descriptors
Multiple indexed ISAM files with both DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access selectors for the same physical file
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP / latin-1 decoded) documenting revision history spanning 2003–2010
No EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3
6 CALL statements, 473 PERFORM statements, only 2 GO TO statements — highly structured
verdict.notes: The file was decoded as latin-1 but the comments contain Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP (or Shift-JIS), which explains the garbled multi-byte characters in the displayed excerpt. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not included in this file; copy_count is reported as 0 by the mechanical scanner, likely because the COPY verb appears inside FD sections and the scanner may not have counted them, but they are clearly present in the source. The program is part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt system maintained by JMA/NACL.
